description: Simulates how changes in load MW, transformer lead times, queue cluster backlog, power prices, or interest rates affect a project's energization schedule, completion probability, and financial returns. Pass any project name, alias, ID, or city.

base_mw.description: Baseline project IT load in megawatts before applying shock (e.g. 200).

delta_cluster_load_mw.description: Change in competing cluster queue load in megawatts (e.g. 1500).

delta_interest_rate_bps.description: Shock to financing interest rate in basis points (e.g. 100).

delta_mw.description: Change in campus load in megawatts between -10000 and 10000 (e.g. 150).

delta_nodal_basis_usd_mwh.description: Shock to nodal LMP congestion spread in USD/MWh (e.g. 15.0).

delta_transformer_lead_weeks.description: Shock to high-voltage transformer lead time in weeks (e.g. 26).

enable_btm_flexibility.description: Whether behind-the-meter generation or load curtailment flexibility is active.

interconnection_queue_cluster_mw_delta.description: Shock to competing local interconnection cluster backlog in MW (e.g. 1000).

location.description: City, county, or location name (e.g. 'Dallas, TX', 'Abilene, TX').

nodal_lmp_basis_spread_delta.description: Shock to nodal LMP basis spread in USD/MWh (e.g. 12.5).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Project ID, canonical ID, or project name (e.g. 'P017', 'AXP-US-TX-00040', 'Stargate Abilene').

project_name.description: Project or campus name (e.g. 'Downtown Dallas Data Center: DFW1', 'Hyperion').

query.description: Project name, alias, or location query (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Dallas, TX').

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

transformer_lead_time_months_delta.description: Shock to high-voltage transformer delivery lead time in months (e.g. 6).

wacc_delta_bps.description: Shock to weighted average cost of capital in basis points (e.g. 150).

name: simulate_grid_to_capital_shock

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.
